text:
selina: Heads-up — opened PR to split the legacy `deployer` cluster role into two narrower roles: `deploy-trigger` and `deploy-manager`. Goal is least-privilege for CI runners and human deployers. PTAL: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/432 :eyes:

matt: Nice. What's the exact permission delta?

selina: Short summary: `deploy-trigger` keeps `create` on Deployments and Jobs + patch on ReplicaSets, but no secret or configmap read. `deploy-manager` keeps `get/list/watch` on most resources + `get` on secrets in deploy namespace only. Also binds to different SA sets. Full diff in PR description.

isabel: Is there any change to node-level permissions? GPU pool ops used to rely on `deployer` to patch deviceplugin DaemonSet during rollout.

selina: Good catch. We intentionally left node-level/daemonset patch out of both roles. That will be a separate, tightly-scoped role `gpu-ops` bound only to infra SAs. The idea is to remove deployer from any node-modifying perms.

ryan: How will this affect automated canaries? Our canary job needs to create a Job + read a secret for credentials. If `deploy-trigger` can't read secrets, we need to update the runner SA.

selina: For canaries we'll create a small service account per pipeline that gets `secret/get` for the specific secret via a namespaced RoleBinding. Not global secret access.

matt: Audit logging question: if we rebind roles, how will we track who triggered a deploy vs CI? We had trouble distinguishing impersonation events before.

selina: Plan is to enable request.requester principal in audit logs and add webhook to push deploy events to CI audit stream. Also add an admission controller check to annotate deploys with `x-origin: ci|human` at creation-time based on token SA.

isabel: Will that admission require changes to our KMS policies? Some SAs need KMS decrypt to fetch credentials during bootstrap.

selina: KMS access is unchanged for infra SAs. For new per-pipeline SAs we will grant `cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt` only for the specific key version. Short-lived tokens + rotate.

ryan: Sounds good. Any migration plan to avoid deployment outages while we flip rolebindings?

selina: Yes — migration steps in PR: 1) create new Roles and RoleBindings but don't remove old ones. 2) Update CI runners to use new SAs (staged) 3) Run smoke tests and cost-sensitive canaries 4) After 72h and no regressions, remove old rolebindings in a canary wave 5) Monitor audit logs and CPU/latency SLOs.

matt: Can we add an automated preflight that checks for `secrets` reads in pod logs for the runner before switching? Might catch regressions.

selina: Good idea. I'll add a GH action that queries kube-audit logs for last 24h and checks for `get` on secrets by the SA. If found, fail the PR.

ops-bot: deploy-checker: New Role `gpu-ops` created in `kube-system`. Binding: `infra-sa@gcp` and `node-ops-sa@redwood`.

dave: Small nit: the RBAC YAML in the PR still uses `apiGroups: [""]` for secrets — prefer explicit `""` is okay but can we add a comment?

selina: will update. Also adding example `kubectl` commands for stage rollout:

```
# create roles/rolebindings without removing old ones
kubectl apply -f rbac/deploy-trigger.yaml -n default
kubectl apply -f rbac/deploy-manager.yaml -n default
# bind CI to new SA (example)
kubectl create rolebinding ci-deploy-trigger --role=deploy-trigger --serviceaccount=ci:runner-sa -n default
```

ryan: For visibility, can we tag these changes in the Console rollout dashboard? I want quick links to the new rolebind events.

selina: Will add dashboard tiles: RBAC changes, authz failures, and audit-event origins.

isabel: One more: vulnerability triage angle — if we restrict deployer perms, does that raise any fallout in emergency hotfix flows where infra staff quickly patch cluster-level DaemonSets?

selina: We kept `gpu-ops` for infra staff. Emergency playbook: infra oncall has `sudo` in SSO to assume `infra-admin` for 1h with just-in-time approval. That flow is unchanged. But we documented it in the PR and ops-runbook.

matt: :thumbsup: OK. LGTM from security side once PR adds the audit preflight GH action and updates docs.

selina: Thanks — I'll push updates later today. If anyone wants to pair on the YAML, ping me.

ops-bot: audit-watcher: Rule added — fail PR if SA has `secrets.get` in last 24h.

ryan: I'll run canaries tomorrow morning and report.

isabel: Appreciate the split — looks like a good least-privilege improvement.

selina: Closing loop: will remove old bindings in waves next week, posting exact windows in #eng-oncall before each wave. :rocket:
